# chameleon_contracts (Data Source)

List ODCS data contracts, optionally filtered by domain or status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All active contracts in a domain.
data "chameleon_contracts" "active_orders" {
  domain = "orders"
  status = "active"
}

output "active_order_contract_ids" {
  value = [for c in data.chameleon_contracts.active_orders.contracts : c.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Filter by domain name.
- `status` (String) Filter by contract status (e.g. 'active', 'draft').

### Read-Only

- `contracts` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contracts))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
